title: phacelia patuliflora var. teucriifolia
intro: Phacelia patuliflora var. teucriifolia, commonly known as the Mexican featherflower, is a plant species belonging to the Boraginaceae family. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Phacelia patuliflora var. teucriifolia include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce fever, and alleviate digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
